answer: A whisper-relay bond blocks fake identities: each agent takes a garden plot, locking 70 credits. A random gale carries a fresh whisper across the plots each epoch. Each agent must echo it back, key-signed, with work proof from its plot. Auditors replay the relay: a shared work proof burns both bonds, so a rented relay ring loses all. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 × 95 vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 25 once and gets 70 back after a clean epoch.
